name: Containment, not a cure

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Carevin hears the account and does not claim he can end the worgen problem. He will make containing their numbers a priority, while the root of the trouble remains beyond the household’s reach. That is the local resolution the quest supports: a promise to resist a danger, not a cure, a recovered weapon, or a verdict on every cause shaping Duskwood. The trail now returns to Darnassus, where Thyn’tel can hear what the mound revealed.
